study: Single weak correction of the predicted clean latent during four-step SDXL-Turbo
scope: Sub-05 personal12, a previously studied participant and panel. Developmental test of a new generation intervention, all 120 queries, four recorded presentations. No model fitting, outcome-selected parameters or new target object words.
inputs: Use prior frozen 512-class personal spatial DCT ridge and its learned per-band gains. The eight permitted supports of the previously predicted object provide the mean; append the EEG-predicted residual about its support EEG mean; wrong exchanges that residual with the registered same-word, same-fold donor. Inverse DCT reconstructs an 8x8 grid of luminance, blue-minus-luminance, red-minus-luminance, and log local contrast. The first three recover 8x8 RGB clipped to [0,1]; local contrast is excluded. Support photo crops only, never current-fold query photos. No image-specific JPEG residual or target pose.
generation: All four arms share the same original 120 words, recipient H14 directions, radius, seeds (923761+archive row) and original batch size 8. Four Euler ancestral steps [999,749,499,249] in the exact native text-to-image pipeline. Encode the bilinearly expanded 8x8 RGB anchor with the frozen float32 VAE posterior mode and model scaling. At t=499 only, current x0 = x - sigma*epsilon. In a 64x64 latent, take 8x8 non-overlapping area means to form an 8x8 grid (4 latent channels); bilinearly upsample the difference of the anchor and x0 block means to 64x64 with align_corners=False. Add 0.35 times this low-frequency residual to x0 by passing epsilon - 0.35*upsampled_difference/sigma to the original scheduler step. Same native noise draw, other three steps unchanged. Native bypasses the hook completely; every native JPEG must hash identically to its archived source before any corrected case may be scored.
primary: All-query DINOv2-S/14 within-object ten-photo top1, 120 rows. Candidate advancement needs own point estimate greater than native and prior, paired 95% lower bound above zero against wrong from 10,000 true-class bootstrap draws (seed 260570) and own 1854-name CLIP credit at least native. Fixed development screen, no participant-population inference.
secondary: CLIP L/14 full 1854 and supplied 12 naming; 32x32 sRGB RMSE and luminance Pearson; independent and strict DINO two-photo assignment when both words correct. The eight supports are part of the ten-photo evaluation gallery for a correct word; the two query photos remain held out. Report if a benefit is attributable to the support prior or shared by wrong recipients.
gallery: Lowest archive row for every true object, include mistakes. Public sheet only generated images; local sheet adds originals.
